handoff: All 7 criteria pass, checked with the real CLI in a throwaway repo (released 0.15.0 → dev build migrate: one R100 commit, pushed, same step; guards for not-held and mid-rebase; flat base record read-only), all tiers green

notes.text: Downgrade hazard (outside this slice's criteria): if released 0.15.0 ticks a checkout holding a story already in round folders, it reads the story as not started and runs story.start again, writing a fresh flat state.json next to rounds/. The dev build then sees both (the resolver prefers flat while state.json exists) and its migrate would collide. AGENTS.md's recovery for a broken release is to reinstall the previous binary, so it may be worth a follow-up issue.
